summary: HiTek Global Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Notice of 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders and proxy statement. The meeting will be held on July 29, 2026. Proposals include re-appointment of directors and auditors, a 1:3,750 subdivision of Class A ordinary shares to reduce par value from $0.375 to $0.0001, authorization for the board to implement one or more share consolidations (aggregate ratio not exceeding 1-for-6,000) within two years, and a name change to Biddance AI Systems, Inc. These are routine governance and capital structure proposals. No special-situation event is disclosed.
